Definition: from a compound of G2095 and G4160; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do good.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses eupoiḯa where we would say to do good. In Hebrews 13:16, the text says "But to do good and to communicate forget not."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, eupoiḯa, does its job quietly — to do good — and I leave it at that.
